name: ascii_banner
description: Draw text as a large banner in a bundled 5-row block font (A-Z, 0-9 and common punctuation; an original font, MIT) with a chosen fill character, letter spacing and word wrapping, optionally inside a border, or put plain text in a box with ASCII, single, double, rounded or heavy line borders and left, centred or right alignment.

fill.description: One character, or "block" for a full block

border.description: Default none for banner, ascii for box

catalog.source: original 5-row block font (MIT) in the manner of FIGlet banners; borders from the Unicode Box Drawing block (U+2500-U+257F)
